text:
Home - SharkSmart

Enjoy NSW beaches. Be SharkSmart.

Find information and resources to help you reduce the risk of a close encounter with a shark at NSW beaches and estuaries. Sharks are a natural part of our marine environment and can be present at any time.

Remember to stay alert to water conditions; check for baitfish, diving birds or dolphins; avoid areas where there are recreational or commercial fishing activities; consider using an independently tested personal deterrent device; and check the SharkSmart app before you go.

NSW Shark Management Program

The NSW Shark Management Program is the largest and most comprehensive program of its kind in the world, with the NSW Government investing approximately $120 million over the next two years to help keep people safer in the water.

Surf Life Saving NSW drone surveillance program

As of 1 July 2026, there are 97 beaches monitored by SLS NSW drone surveillance across the state under the NSW Shark Management Program. Under the expanded program, 72 beaches benefit from drone monitoring 365 days of the year, including at least one beach in every coastal local government area.

Stay SharkSmart with our app. Check the latest sightings and tagged shark detections before you hit the water in NSW.
